values.description: Firecrawl API through the api container.
llama-swap reached directly, not through Firecrawl. Held here (rather than only in .env) so the Postman cloud runner has it. Leave the trailing /v1 off: the request appends /v1/models itself.
Secret, injected by postman/run.sh from .env.prod. Gates the Bull Board request under Queue Admin.
OpenCode Zen host root, no /v1 - the request appends /v1/systemone itself. Leave the trailing /v1 off or it becomes /v1/v1/systemone.
Secret, injected by postman/run.sh from .env.prod. The Jev request skips itself when this is empty, so a runner without it is not a failure.
Model named in the Jev request body; the response is asserted to echo it.

SearXNG reached directly, same host as SEARXNG_ENDPOINT in .env. Leave no trailing slash: the requests append /search and /config themselves. Must be filled here, not left blank - an environment variable shadows the collection variable of the same name, so a blank value breaks the SearXNG folder.
